value.rationale: Natural, complete rank-by-rank classification of exact equality plateaus of overlapping order statistics. The nontrivial structural transition is that every fixed rank above the maximum has no limiting full-window atom while the maximum retains mass 1/4; explicit dependence duration distribution and expectation support study of reused extremes in sliding-block estimation. Not a routine parameter substitution of a previously proved maximum formula.
